original.statement: The Host and HostRegexp router rule matchers were reworked; the evidence does not say how their behavior changed.

decision.reason: [ev-7cea1050ccfe] says the Host and HostRegexp rule matchers were reworked, and the release lists this under "Bug fixes". So the matching behaviour of these two matchers changed, while the configuration surface the text names stays the same. The subject is a kebab-case name built from the evidence's own words, and behavior-changed is the least specific change type the text supports. The evidence does not say how the behaviour changed, so applicability and consequence stay undetermined. That is why confidence is low.
